messages.en: My dad's downstairs already. I'll head down now, okay?
Okay, see you tomorrow. Say hi to your dad for me.
Has your dad got home yet?
Yes, Mum. Dad's eating in the kitchen.

collocations.en: look after his or her father
follow in his or her father's footsteps

messages.en: Hana said her dad's already at the clinic.
Oh, is she going to keep her dad company?
I'm going to get chicken rice from that shop up ahead. Want me to get you some too?
Yes, just one portion to go. A thigh piece, please. Thanks!
